explanation:
The flow starts at `CheckoutPage` (client/src/pages/CheckoutPage.tsx:9).

1. `CheckoutPage` calls `useCart()` and `handleCheckout()` on onClick.
2. `useCart()` sends `GET /api/cart`.
3. `handleCheckout()` calls `createOrder()` and `Stripe.js: confirmCardPayment`; checks `result.error` (yes → `navigate /checkout/failed`; no → `navigate /orders/:param`).
4. `createOrder()` sends `POST /api/orders`.
5. `POST /api/orders` runs middleware `requireAuth()` and `validateBody()`; calls `OrdersController.create()`.
6. `requireAuth()` reads `session.findUnique`; checks `!session || session.expiresAt < new Date()` (yes → `401 Unauthorized`).
7. `validateBody()` checks `!result.success` (yes → `400 Bad Request`).
8. `OrdersController.create()` calls `getCart()` and `validateCart()`; checks `!validation.ok` (yes → `400 Bad Request`; no → `OrderService.createOrder()`, `createPaymentIntent()`).
9. `getCart()` reads `cartItem.findMany`.
10. `OrderService.createOrder()` calls `cartTotal()` and `reserveInventory()`; writes `order.create`; emits `order.created`.
11. `createPaymentIntent()` calls `Stripe: paymentIntents.create`.
12. `reserveInventory()` writes `product.update`; checks `product.stock < 0` (yes → `throw OutOfStockError`).
13. `Stripe: paymentIntents.create` leads to `POST /api/webhooks/stripe` (inferred).
14. `POST /api/webhooks/stripe` calls `handleStripeWebhook()`.
15. `handleStripeWebhook()` calls `Stripe: webhooks.constructEvent`; on error: `400 Bad Request`; checks `switch (event.type)` (payment_intent.succeeded → `markOrderPaid()`; payment_intent.payment_failed → `markOrderFailed()`).
16. `markOrderPaid()` writes `order.update`; emits `emails queue`.
17. `markOrderFailed()` writes `order.update`; calls `releaseInventory()`; emits `order.paymentFailed`.
18. `emails queue` triggers `worker emails handler`.
19. `releaseInventory()` reads `cartItem.findMany`; writes `product.update`.
20. `order.paymentFailed` triggers `notifyPaymentFailed()`.
21. `worker emails handler` checks `job.name === "order-confirmation"` (yes → `sendOrderConfirmation()`).
22. `notifyPaymentFailed()` calls `sendPaymentFailedEmail()`.
23. `sendPaymentFailedEmail()` reads `order.findUnique`; calls `Resend: emails.send`.
24. `sendOrderConfirmation()` reads `order.findUnique`; calls `Resend: emails.send`.
